text: I’ve been dealing with chronic pain for over 2 years, and finding people who truly listen and take the time to understand can make a huge difference. The team here was very kind, patient, and professional. They took their time to listen carefully and really tried to understand every symptom and concern instead of rushing through the appointment. I already felt relief after just one assessment and one treatment session, which honestly gave me hope after struggling for a long time. I’m very grateful for the care and attention I received and I definitely plan on going back. Thank you again.

Having pulled my back and potentially inverted my back disc. I was treated by gift. All relieving my pain and helping get me comfortable again. I am so grateful. Also , good communication thru whatsapp for documents and ecercise advise. Always on hand for follow up and appointment queries. Easy to find and excellent service throughout. If you have serious muscle strain or pain dont suffer. Take a visit. Very affordable price and youll be amazed how effective it can be.

I received treatment for a muscle and spinal injury after repeated pain killer doses did not take. Feom the first treatment to the last. The aftercare. Simplicity of use, appointment,communication were all excellent. Gift is a great therapist , i received ultrasound and electric treatment. Also some exercises and stretch to help treat the problems and their cause. I felt the cost was very fair and was matched with a hogh level of service.

I recommend highly. If your suffering any pain or muscle injuries. They really are miracle workers.

I had an excellent experience at Samui Physio Clinic. I went in for upper back and neck pain that I’ve had for years, and after just a several sessions, I feel a lot better. They took the time to explain exactly what was wrong and gave me easy exercises to do at home. The clinic is clean, professional, and the staff is incredibly friendly. Highly recommended

Yada was incredibly kind, professional, and attentive. From the first session, she took the time to really understand what was going on and explained things clearly. Her approach was calm and reassuring, and the treatment made a noticeable difference very quickly. I felt genuinely well taken care of and in good hands throughout the session. Thank you, Yada, for your help and your positive energy.

The treatment of my twisted ankle was new for me, but worked very well (laser and ultrasound therapy)! Perfect, friendly & uncomplicated service for appointments and invoicing. All in all,  very recommendable. Thanks for getting much better! :)

I.find all the staff very helpful and courteous.
I would recommend GIFT and the staff, for anyone who needs Physio.

Gift was very kind, professional and took great care of understanding my problem before proposing an adequate treatment. Thank you so much Yada!  (& Riza)

100% Highly recommended. The clinic is very new, very good and modern equipment, and very clean. All the therapist speak very good English and they take care you during and after the treatment. Thank you!

Extremely qualified staff and state of the art clinic.

Highly recommend!

I went in for treatment on my plantar fascia, and from the very first visit, I knew I was in the right hands. The clinic itself is clean, well-equipped, and has a welcoming atmosphere that immediately puts you at ease.

A special thank you to Gift, my therapist, who was not only incredibly skilled and professional but also one of the kindest and most caring practitioners I've ever met. She took the time to understand my pain, explained the treatment process clearly, and worked with precision and expertise to relieve my discomfort. After just a few sessions, I felt a significant improvement, and now I can walk without the constant pain that had been bothering me for so long.

If you're in Koh Samui and need top-notch physiotherapy, don't hesitate to visit Samui Physio Clinic. Their team is fantastic, and their dedication to their patients is truly outstanding. Thank you again, Gift and the whole team, for your amazing care! 🙌😊

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 Highly Recommended!

I came to Samui Physio Clinic with a grade 2 calf tear and was treated by Gift and Yada, who were both absolutely amazing. When I first arrived, I was on crutches with an aircast, but after just 5 sessions I was able to walk on my own again. They used infrared and electro-ultrasound therapies, and everything was done with great professionalism and care. I truly appreciate all their help and highly recommend this clinic to anyone in need of physiotherapy on the island.

A very good clinic with professional staff and true diagnosis. I suffered from lower back problem and it really helped me to get better, release the pain and move good again. I am very happy and so thankful for all the staff did for me and of course I truly recommend this place ;-)

I highly recommend on end them and I will be visiting again for sure.

Such a fantastic clinic, would definitely recommend. We went through a thorough consultation and examination prior to starting any treatment, I was provided with diagrams to ensure I understood what the diagnosis was, where was effected and what needed to be done. Alongside treatment at the clinic I was prescribed an at home stretching routine and was able to WhatsApp with the clinic.

Great value for money, far better treatment and service than I have received privately in London.

Extremely friendly and professional staff, lovely environment. Thank you so much to Gift for helping me!

Very impressed. I've had serious low back issues for years (prolapsed discs needing fusion surgery), it can get very bad real quick, making me unable to walk or even stand for weeks. I tweaked my back while carrying my suitcase and I thought my holidays were ruined. I was able to get an appontment for the following day but I wasn't holding my breath, as it's usually too late when my back goes this bad.
But... Gift was amazing and she sorted it! I felt much better some hours after my 1st session, and I did 2 more.
It was truly unbelievable. She used machines that we don't have over here in Australia and the results are incredible!
It literally saved my holidays. I genuinely wish I could find such a good physio in Queensland, who uses the same techniques.
I higly recommend! Just trust their method and do the exercices they tell you to do. 👍👍👍
Thank you Gift!

I was looking for a chiropractor, so I didn’t have high hopes when I booked my first appointment. I was immediately impressed by their professionalism, expertise, and the results I got. After my first session, the issue I went in for was no longer an issue so, since I had signed up for a package of five sessions I just kept going and getting work done on my neck. I had no idea that Physio could work as well, if not better than chiropractic. My physiotherapist diagnosed my issue as a muscle issue, not a spine issue. In all of my years of using chiropractors, nobody has ever said that to me before.  The results were amazing.  The staff is very friendly and we’ll go out of their way to make you feel good. When I left Ko Samui, I was sad to leave this Clinic behind.
The clinic is spotless and the treatment rooms are beautifully decorated with calming music playing. You are offered water and green tea. …

I visited the clinic following an injury sustained during training. Over the course of two days, Yada provided treatment focused on my psoas muscle, which resulted in significant relief. The clinic maintains a very high standard of cleanliness and professionalism, and my appointment was conducted promptly at the scheduled time. I would highly recommend this clinic to anyone seeking quality care.

Excellent staff and experts. We came here due to my knee injury and my sons neck and posture problems. After only 3 treatments my knee was 95% healed, i had to leave Samui, but after that the rest healed on it's own so now I am 100% recovered. Thank you Tam!
Karim helped my son with neck and posture issues, great expert as well so we are very happy with the service at Samui Physio.
Thank you for everything!

I’d have happily gone back for a third session but was leaving Samui so couldn’t, Tan gave me a full assessment report and a series of exercises to do to continue recovery.
The clinic is about one year old, really clean and all the staff have excellent English too. Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Samui Physio Clinic.

I was 13 weeks post pattela detachment surgery when I arrived to Koh Samui. I paid for 5 sessions at a very affordable price, especially comparable to in Western Countries. The physio's (I seen three of the 4) where all very knowledgeable and gave me a combination of great treatment as well as exercises for home. I am very excited to say that my mobility has returned to almost 100% in 2 weeks and 5 treatments. Gift, one of the Physio's was very kind and helped me address my pain and mobility and I am so appreciative. The reception was also very helpful and worked with me to schedule around my Holiday. I highly recommend this business and will come back next time I'm in Samui even if I have no injuries.

Thank You Krup

Excellent experience! I came in for some last-minute treatment before my next overseas trip and made tremendous progress in just a few days.

My patellar tendonitis flared up pretty badly when I arrived on the Island. Could barely walk even with a cane and limited range of motion. After 3 sessions within 4 days I can now walk properly with only minor discomfort, restore range of motion and swim in a pool pain-free.

Karim, my therapist, did a throughout examination before the 1st treatment. The procedure included ultrasound with electric stimulation, laser therapy, manual mobilization followed by application of K-tape and exercise routine for me. A detailed message was sent to me explaining all the details. I wished I’ve traveled here sooner. Thank you Karim!

Just had one session with these guys and 98% of my pain is gone already.

If you have sciatic pain like I had, don’t wait - go and see this clinic! 🙏

I turned to the clinic for help with severe periarthritis of the shoulder joint.  The arm could not rise due to severe pain.  I didn't sleep for several nights.  And they helped me there!!!  Inflammation and pain were relieved without pills …

Tweaked my back on the way to Samui and had lower back pain for a few days before seeking treatment. After one treatment with Tan at Samui Physio Clinic and i was almost fully recovered. I highly recommend this physio clinic and Tan as she is very qualified.

After the first session I felt a big pain relief already and after about 5 to 6 sessions the problem dissappeared almost fully. Also pricewise it's way more affordable than in Bangkok and I can highly recommend this Physio here in Samui. I've then continued the sessions while the pain has been stablelized and sometimes weeks or months go by where I forgot that I ever had it. That's an amazing improvement!

Exceptional clinic. The level of service and care was world class and the staff we’re super friendly and helpful. Bume is highly qualified and really knows what she’s talking about. I’ve had neck pain from tech neck syndrome for over a year …

Modern, new equipment,  skilled and caring physical therapists at this clinic.  Came in for an injured shoulder that had limited mobility with pain, with some other aches as well. Gift was able to provide treatment that healed my injured shoulder.  Highly recommended 👌 …

I pulled my hamstring while training and needed help to recover. The facility and staff were great. I had three different treatments over the course of 2 weeks and saw a huge improvement with my hamstring. Thank you!
Gift was the best! Helped me so much, and very friendly!

I attended this clinic whilst in Samui for ongoing shoulder pain I'd been experiencing whilst travelling. It was very easy to make an appointment with the clinic who responded to my email immediately.  I had an appointment the next day. All staff spoke excellent English including the lovely friendly receptionist.  The treatment lasted an hour. It was instantly effective with use of tens machine & combined ultrasound with electric stimulation, I think possibly her name is Rung. I booked a 2nd appointment for the same week. The 2nd Physio called Gift was very good at explaining the equipment which I haven't seen in the UK. She used a fantastic combination of heat, massage,  Stretching & ultrasound electric stimulation to help relieve my pain. Again over an hour for treatment. She kindly sent me a follow up message with advice and pictures of the stretches she advise I perform. Excellent experience, wonderful talented staff. I'm sorry I'm not staying longer to avail of further treatment. Thank you Samui Physio Clinic
Gift is a highly competent, gentle, and extremely attentive physiotherapist. I recommend her without hesitation.
